profile_text.body:
Salesforce is a public company, founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, that trades under the ticker CRM. Its most recent filing in the record is a 10-K for the period ending 2026-01-31, reporting revenue of 41525000000 US dollars. The company's site material reviewed here centers on Slack, which it describes as a conversational interface for AI features and for Agentforce, its agent product.

The site describes AI in Slack as a tool for summarizing channels and threads, searching files, taking meeting notes, translating conversations, and building automations. It says Slackbot acts as a personal AI agent that understands a user's workspace and adapts to their style, and that AI features are available across all paid Slack plans. On data handling, the company states that customer data is not used to train large language models, that LLM providers do not have access to customer data, and that the models are hosted within Slack's AWS virtual private cloud. It also says agents built with Agentforce can run in Slack channels, threads, and direct messages.

Beyond Slack, the record lists Tableau AI (Einstein) for business intelligence with natural language queries and Trust Layer governance, and Salesforce Einstein / Agentforce for CRM-embedded AI and agents. Several MCP servers are tracked for Salesforce administration, SOQL querying, and deployment planning, including ai.cirra/salesforce-mcp, ai.smithery/kodey-ai-salesforce-mcp, ai.smithery/kodey-ai-salesforce-mcp-kodey, ai.smithery/kodey-ai-salesforce-mcp-minimal, ai.smithery/kodey-ai-salesforce-mcp-server, and cloud.serpent/salesforce-devops. The record shows no lawsuits and notes California as a jurisdiction with 281 entries.
